lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cd2Sn4 (CdSn2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4_1md (No. 143), with six atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Cd and Sn centers adopting close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors each: Cd is surrounded by 12 Sn neighbors, while Sn is coordinated by 4 Cd and 8 Sn neighbors, with distances spanning roughly 3.14–3.26 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D component containing all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Sn-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Cd- and Sn-centered polyhedra.
